Tournament review ==== [[Club Atlético River Plate|River Plate]], [[Boca Juniors]] and [[Club Atlético Vélez Sarsfield|Velez Sarsfield]] were the teams who kept the league's lead for most of the tournament (except for Round 4, when the temporary leader was [[Rosario Central]], who finished fourth), and those three teams were the ones who arrived at the last rounds with possibilities of winning the tournament. Velez Sarsfield started the tournament with three consecutive wins, obtaining the lead at the end of Round 3. Boca Juniors went on a winning streak from rounds 3 to 7, winning five consecutive games, taking the lead at the end of Round 5. On May 4, 2003, during Round 11, Velez Sarsfield got a home win against leaders Boca Juniors{{cite web |url=https://www.clarin.com/deportes/ballottage-clausura-velez-hace-frente-river-boca_0_SyD_9-xRtx.html |title = En el "ballottage" del Clausura, Vélez les hace frente a River y a Boca - 06/05/2003 - Clarín.com |date = 6 May 2003 |access-date=2018-02-22 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180423231226/https://www.clarin.com/deportes/ballottage-clausura-velez-hace-frente-river-boca_0_SyD_9-xRtx.html |archive-date=2018-04-23 }} "In the "ballottage" of the Clausura, Vélez faces River and Boca" (in Spanish) and after three more consecutive wins, regained the top position in the league. On June 1, during Round 14, Boca Juniors and River Plate confronted each other in the [[Superclásico]] at [[La Bombonera|Boca Juniors stadium]]. The game ended 2-2 and allowed Velez, who won their match, to be the sole leaders of the league. However, an unexpected home loss to [[Club Olimpo|Olimpo]] on Round 15, made Velez lose the first position{{cite web |url=https://www.lanacion.com.ar/502080-sorpresa-en-liniers-olimpo-derroto-a-velez-1-a-0 |title = Sorpresa en Liniers: Olimpo derrotó a Vélez 1 a 0 - LA NACION |access-date=2018-02-22 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180423231226/https://www.lanacion.com.ar/502080-sorpresa-en-liniers-olimpo-derroto-a-velez-1-a-0 |archive-date=2018-04-23 }} "Surprise in Liniers: Olimpo defeated Vélez 1-0" (in Spanish) as Boca and River won their matches against [[Club Atlético Huracán|Huracán]] and [[San Lorenzo de Almagro|San Lorenzo]] respectively. At the end of the matchday, Boca Juniors were the new leaders. On June 15, during Round 16, River Plate defeated [[Club Atlético Lanús|Lanús]] and because Velez and Boca tied their games, finished the match day as sole leaders.{{cite web |url=https://www.lanacion.com.ar/504218-trepada-river-a-la-punta-con-goles-y-decision |title = Trepada: River, a la punta con goles y decisión - LA NACION |access-date=2018-02-22 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180423231226/https://www.lanacion.com.ar/504218-trepada-river-a-la-punta-con-goles-y-decision |archive-date=2018-04-23 }} "Rise: River, to the top with goals and decision" (in Spanish) On June 29, during Round 18, River defeated Olimpo in [[Bahía Blanca]] and won the championship, by getting a difference of 4 points to rivals Boca Juniors, with only 1 round to go.{{cite web |url=http://edant.clarin.com/suplementos/especiales/2003/06/30/l-582185.htm |title = River gritó campeón en Bahía Blanca y se escuchó en todo el país |access-date=2018-02-22
